en.headline: CHP investigates two confirmed Mpox cases, urges high-risk groups to vaccinate
en.dek: A 38-year-old man and a 34-year-old man tested positive; both had high-risk exposure in Hong Kong during the incubation period and are in stable condition under isolation.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health said on Wednesday that it is investigating two confirmed Mpox cases and strongly urged high-risk target groups to receive Mpox vaccination. The public was advised to remain vigilant and avoid close physical contact with anyone suspected of infection.

The first case involves a 38-year-old man who developed genital ulcers on 19 August. He sought treatment at a Department of Health social hygiene service clinic on 31 August. According to information he provided, he had sexual contact with his male partner in Hong Kong during the incubation period. The second case involves a 34-year-old man who developed fever on 27 August and a sore throat on 29 August. He attended the Accident and Emergency Department of Caritas Medical Centre the same day and was admitted. Rashes appeared on his face, neck, trunk, limbs, buttock and genital area on 1 September. He reported high-risk exposure with three male strangers in Hong Kong during the incubation period.

Both clinical specimens tested positive for the monkeypox virus at the CHP’s Public Health Laboratory Services Branch. The patients have been arranged isolation treatment in hospital and are in stable condition. No epidemiological link has been identified between the two cases or with earlier confirmed cases in Hong Kong. The CHP is continuing epidemiological investigations, will contact individuals who had high-risk contact with the patients, and will report the cases to the World Health Organization. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 99 Mpox cases, comprising 79 local and 20 imported cases; all patients were male.

zh.headline: 防護中心調查兩宗猴痘確診 籲高風險群組接種疫苗
zh.dek: 38歲及34歲男病人分別確診，潛伏期內均在港有高風險接觸，現於醫院隔離治療，情況穩定。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心周三表示，正調查兩宗猴痘確診個案，並強烈建議高風險目標群組人士接種猴痘疫苗。市民應提高警覺，避免與懷疑感染人士作密切身體接觸。

首宗個案涉及一名38歲男子，他自8月19日起生殖器官出現潰瘍，因症狀持續於8月31日到衞生署社會衞生科診所求診。根據病人提供的資料，他於潛伏期內曾在香港與其男性伴侶有性接觸。第二宗個案涉及一名34歲男子，他於8月27日出現發燒，8月29日出現喉嚨痛，同日到明愛醫院急症室求診並留院。他於9月1日起面部、頸部、軀幹、四肢、生殖器官及臀部出現皮疹。根據病人提供的資料，他於潛伏期內曾在香港與三名陌生男子有高風險接觸。
兩人的臨床樣本經防護中心公共衞生化驗服務處化驗後，證實對猴痘病毒呈陽性反應。中心已安排他們在醫院接受隔離治療，目前情況穩定。暫時沒有資料顯示兩宗個案之間或與本港早前錄得的其他猴痘確診個案有流行病學關連。中心正繼續進行流行病學調查，會設法聯繫曾與病人有高風險接觸的人士，並會將個案通報世界衞生組織。自2022年起至今，本港共錄得99宗猴痘個案，包括79宗本地個案及20宗輸入個案，全部病人均為男性。
